lead.title: Scanvio Medical wins CE mark (Class IIa, MDR) for Scanvio Assist, billed as the first AI-assisted ultrasound for endometriosis
lead.deck: The software, assessed by notified body TÜV SÜD (NB2443) under EU MDR 2017/745, works with existing ultrasound machines and guides the transvaginal exam in real time; it is also offered to ultrasound makers as an add-on. For a young Swiss company, it is the step to commercial stage in a diagnosis that is still slow to reach.

milestone.title: DeepPsy wins CHF 1.99M from the Swiss National Science Foundation for PRECISE MDD, a 500-patient trial of its EEG/ECG software in depression
milestone.summary: Four-year randomised, triple-blind trial: the software extracts biomarkers from EEG and ECG recordings and produces a report comparing approved treatments, tested against reports based on standard recommendations. Sites are in Zurich, Bern and Basel, and an independent academic consortium runs the study.
milestone.why: Non-dilutive public money paying for the clinical proof of a precision-psychiatry software; the head-to-head design and healthcare-cost follow-up are what payers require for reimbursement.

brefsEurope.title: PolaSight, a University of Bern spin-off, gets $100,000 from Constructor Capital for PolaOne, its label-free imaging for cancer surgery
brefsEurope.summary: PolaOne combines polarised light and AI to produce a live tissue map in about a minute. A small cheque, awarded at the Constructor Start Demo Day, but an early signal on a company with no announced round yet.

brefsIntl.title: Briya: its AIRE AI identifies 360% more patients with steatotic liver disease in ultrasound reports
brefsIntl.summary: Across 28,795 reports (20,422 patients, 2020-2024) at Shaare Zedek Medical Center, natural-language processing lifts identified patients from 1,122 to 5,158; only 22% of the new cases had a diagnosis in the structured record.

brefsIntl.title: Boston Scientific sues Atraverse Medical (J&J) for patent infringement over the Hotwire transseptal guidewire
brefsIntl.summary: Complaint filed July 11 in Delaware and made public October 8; Hotwire was FDA-cleared in December 2025 and J&J acquired Atraverse in April 2026. A competition signal in atrial fibrillation ablation, where European players are positioning.

brefsIntl.title: Stryker: Kevin Lobo steps down after 15+ years as CEO, Spencer Stiles succeeds him on January 1, 2027
brefsIntl.summary: COO Spencer Stiles, 50 and nearly 30 years at the group, becomes CEO; Lobo stays on as executive chair. An internal succession at one of the biggest medtech acquirers, so a stable potential buyer for orthopaedic and robotics startups.

word.definition: Software that on its own, without being part of a hardware device, serves a medical purpose (helping diagnose, monitor or choose a treatment) and therefore needs a CE mark or FDA authorisation like any device.

how.t: The software is shown to pursue a claimed medical purpose without being embedded in a hardware device.
A notified body assesses the file according to risk class (Class IIa for Scanvio Assist, assessed by TÜV SÜD).
Clinical studies show real-world value, for example a randomised trial like PRECISE MDD for DeepPsy.

word.why: For a VC, software copies at low marginal cost but the moat is regulatory: a CE mark or FDA clearance is a balance-sheet asset that can be sold to hardware makers, as Scanvio offers to ultrasound manufacturers.
